verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an ES|QL REST API, but nothing shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The probe of common OpenAPI/Swagger paths on elastic.co returned 404 for every candidate. The llms.txt and markdown docs are AI-readable documentation, an adjacent feature that is not an API specification, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
